purpose: The Milestone 4 baselines beyond the pooled rate, fitted on each development fold's training blocks and scored on its test block, for the three B-clock primary targets in both versions (all_event and clean_window). The holdout is sealed and the C0-clock targets are not run. Every contrast is model minus comparator, lower is better. A status is never a claim of a tradable or production-ready edge.
